_comment: Surge mob pool. 'entity' is an entity id, or a #tag. weight = spawn chance relative to the others (0 = never spawned by the surge, but still gets gear when it spawns naturally during one). equip=false = no gear. gear_multiplier scales this mob's gear tier. slots = which slots get gear (head, chest, legs, feet, mainhand, offhand). Any mod or datapack can add its own file in data/<namespace>/spiresurge/mobs/.
